notes: Answered calendars hold two external meetings and absent ones three, the same two plus a subject no page carries. Each calendar draws on one bundle (a governing page and a person, or two people at different companies), so its tasks form one group, and the absent meeting adds an abstention without adding a page.

person-meeting and account-meeting count the meetings the oracle screens before any calendar is built; neither family is placed. The person drops are people whose affiliation the oracle cannot confirm, for v1's reasons. account-meeting appears only when a governing row fails the oracle.
